sources: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 232283 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232283 (notice: 'All reservable sites, except 26, 33 and 41 (tent-only) have electric hookups; sites 5, 10, 15, 16, 18 and 62 have 20, 30 and 50 amp service available') + RIDB catalog (bookable sites 005/010/015/016/018/062 'Electricity Hookup 50'), read 2026-11-11

sites.source: RIDB campsite catalog for 232283 (fetched 2026-10-20): longest 'Max Vehicle Length' on an RV site is 40 ft (driveways run longer, up to 67 ft, but the posted vehicle limit is 40); 53 of 56 RV sites allow 23 ft or more; 5 pull-through sites (005, 010, 015, 016, 018). rec.gov: 'Many sites at Fall Lake are made to accommodate RVs including pull-through sites.' Read 2026-11-11

values.note: Store, canoe rentals, firewood and ice; swimming beach and playground; host on site in season.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232283 (amenities 'Showers', 'Accessible Flush Toilets', 'Accessible Vault Toilets', 'Drinking Water'; description 'A store, canoe rentals, firewood and ice are available at the facility, and a campground host is on-site during the season'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: A reserved site is held until noon the day after the arrival date, then released.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232283 ('This lake has some sites that can be reserved and some that are first-come, first-served'; maxConsecutiveStay 14; RIDB catalog: 14 non-reservable standard electric sites; notice on held reservations), read 2026-11-11

values.note: recreation.gov 2026 and 2027 peak seasons: standard electric $40; the $30 non-electric rate applies only to tent-only sites. One RV with tow vehicle per site; most sites take one extra vehicle for a per-night fee (amount not stated).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232283/rates (2026-05-01..09-26 and 2027-05-01..09-25 Peak Season: STANDARD ELECTRIC 40, STANDARD NONELECTRIC 30 (no such RV site in the catalog), TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC 30) + facility rules hasTaxes 1 + notice 'One RV with tow vehicle per single site ... Most sites can accommodate 1 extra vehicle that is not included with the reservation fee', read 2026-11-11

note: Superior NF (Kawishiwi District) campground ~6 mi E of Ely with direct access into the Boundary Waters (a BWCAW permit is needed past the wilderness line on the lake); swimming beach, boat ramp and a 1.5-mile hiking trail. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + RIDB read: 50-amp on six sites (all reservable non-tent sites electric), pull-throughs, showers/flush+vault toilets/water/store, some sites FCFS, 14-night max; changed max_rig_ft 52 -> 40 (posted vehicle limit) and nightly_low 30 -> 40 (the $30 rate is tent-only). Season dates not settled (rec.gov peak season 05-01..09-26 in 2026).
flags: Fees: the stored $30 low was the STANDARD NONELECTRIC/TENT ONLY rate; the RIDB catalog has no non-electric RV site, so the cheapest site a 23-ft rig fits is standard electric at $40 (under US$50).
